name: Segmented Dataset Quantization
definition: A method for segmented datasets where small blocks are quantized to have only one or two different components inside. Encoded data consists of the block type and the splitting plane which subdivides the block.
summary: Segmented Dataset Quantization is a lossy compression technique for volumetric segmentation data that reduces storage by encoding blocks with one or two labels and their separating planes, explicitly modeling discrete categorical boundaries unlike general-purpose texture compression.
